SECCANT – REGENERATION DRYER
These regeneration dryers operate in the 25 to 420 bar pressure ranges.
SECCANT is suited for drying air and gases at high service per­formances and
F.A.D.s or at higher ambient temperatures. Further­more, the regeneration dryer
is equipped as standard with electronic control, soft change-over between
regeneration and load cycle, pre-­separation and a particle filter. Even the basic
version of the the SECCANT is designed for easy integration into the complete
system. Also, these dryers can be expanded as required to include activated
carbon adsorbers for removing oil and transforming CO.

PX-FILTER
BAUER PX series of medium and high-pressure coalescing and active charcoal filters
are designed to remove particulates, oil droplets and aerosols. They are suitable for
air, nitrogen, helium, argon and other gases. Various air/gas quality standards in accor-
dance with ISO 8573 up to class 1 can be produced depending on the filter type and
filter combination.

What
pressure ranges does the GIB 23 series cover?
Depending on the configuration and available inlet pressure, GIB 23 high-pressure booster compressors achieve final pressures of approximately 90 to 420 bar.
What
flow rates do the GIB 23 boosters provide?
The GIB 23 series covers flow rates of approximately 1,450 to 3,900 litres per minute. The actual flow rate depends on the inlet pressure, final pressure and system configuration.
Which
gases can be compressed with GIB 23 boosters?
GIB 23 boosters are designed for the compression of Air, Nitrogen, Helium, Heliox and Argon. They are specifically developed for industrial applications with increased pressure requirements.
How
are GIB 23 boosters controlled and monitored?
The boosters are equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system. It enables easy operation, reliable monitoring of all relevant operating parameters and connection to the B-CLOUD and the B-APP for digital system monitoring.
What
advantages does the B-CLOUD offer for GIB 23 booster applications?
The B-CLOUD enables digital remote monitoring of the booster system. Operating data, alarms and system statuses can be accessed in real time, supporting predictive maintenance and high system availability.

1: Details & Features
The modular storage system is the ideal supplement for compressor units and ensures stable pressure supply for air and Nitrox applications. Available in pressure levels of 330, 350, and 420 bar, it minimizes pressure fluctuations during peak withdrawals and reduces the number of compressor start-ups.: Flexible expansion using 50- or 80-liter storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to individual demand, supporting smooth and efficient operation.
Storage cylinder with console: A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
Pressure vessel: The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.
Condensate drain: Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Options: Safety valve and pressure gauge
Safety valve and pressure gauge are mounted on the console of the first module. This is mandatory if exceeding the maximum permissible storage pressure cannot be otherwise avoided, e.g. by approved safety valves on the compressor or in the pipeline.: The storage design
Storage system design – the basis for efficient compressor operation: A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.
To ensure optimal operation, the compressor should ideally run no more than two to four cycles per hour. BAUER industrial compressors are equipped with cycle counters as standard, which record actual start cycles and support safe, efficient system control.: The size of the storage system depends on:

What
is the I26 series used for?
The I26 series comprises water-cooled high-pressure compressors for the compression of air and nitrogen. It is used whenever these gases need to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures and supplied over long periods in continuous operation. Typical applications include industrial compressed air and nitrogen supply, process gas systems, research and development, test facilities and applications with permanent high-pressure demand where thermal stability and high operational reliability are required.
What
performance ranges does the I26 series cover?
The I26 high-pressure compressors achieve final pressures from 90 to 420 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 2,200 to 3,300 litres per minute, depending on configuration, inlet pressure and operating conditions. This makes the series suitable for medium to high-capacity industrial applications in continuous operation.

Document: B-SELECT_en
Page 1

Status: 02/04/2026
B-SELECT
Automatic selector unit

For simultaneous filling of pressure cylinders with air from
storage system and compressor
Inlet pressure up to 420 bar
Flow rate up to 850 bar

The automatic selector unit enables compressed air cylinders to be filled quickly and simultaneously in parallel from
a single storage system (buffer) and via one compressor.
Important! The automatic selector unit works most effectively when the nominal pressure in the storage system
and the breathing air cylinder are nearly the same.

HOW IT WORKS
Filling of the breathing air cylinder connected to the filling panel takes priority. This means that the storage system
and the compressor always fill the cylinder connected to the filling panel first. Once the cylinders are completely
filled, the automatic selector unit independently switches over to filling the storage system.

When the maximum filling pressure of the storage system is reached, the compressor shuts down fully
automatically. As soon as the next empty breathing air cylinder is connected to the filling panel, the storage system
again fills the breathing air cylinder first. If the preset restart pressure in the storage system is undershot, the
compressor switches on.

The compressor then fills the breathing air cylinder up to the value preset on the backpressure regulator / pressure

What delivery rates are possible with PE-VE compressors?
PE-VE compressors achieve delivery rates of approximately 85 to 800 l/min. The actual delivery rate depends on the model and the specific configuration.
Which gases are PE-VE compressors suitable for?
PE-VE compressors are designed for the compression of air, nitrogen, and forming gas. They are intended for reliable continuous operation in industrial environments.
What technically distinguishes PE-VE compressors?
The systems are based on proven BAUER high-pressure blocks and are designed for robustness, long service life, and continuous industrial duty. The design focuses on reliable technology and an especially attractive price-performance ratio.
How are PE-VE compressors controlled and monitored?
The compressor is equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system. It enables easy operation, safe monitoring of operating parameters, and connectivity to the B-CLOUD and B-APP.
What
are the benefits of B-CLOUD?
B-CLOUD enables centralized digital monitoring of the compressor. Operators have continuous access to operating data, can monitor system status, and plan maintenance more efficiently.

Details & Features
The water-cooled high-pressure boosters in the GIB series from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are ideal for demanding industrial applications in continuous operation. Thanks to targeted water cooling of the compressor blocks and multi-stage compression, operating temperatures remain low and wear is minimised. The systems offer maximum gas tightness for loss-free compression up to 520 bar. Proven BAUER system components, robust construction and optimised power consumption ensure maximum efficiency. The modular storage system is the ideal addition to compressor systems and ensures a stable pressure supply for air and gas applications. Available in pressure stages of 330 bar and 420 bar, it reduces pressure fluctuations during peak demand and reduces the frequency of compressor start-ups. Flexible expansion with 50- or 80-litre storage cylinders allows the system to be tailored precisely to requirements and supports smooth, efficient system operation.

A module consists of a storage cylinder that is pre-piped and ready for connection, mounted on a console for floor or wall installation. Based on 50 l or 80 l storage cylinders, these storage systems can be expanded as required.
The storage cylinders comply with DGRL2014/68/EU (PED) and are intended for stationary applications.

Depending on the application or due to insufficient air or gas treatment, condensate can accumulate in high-pressure storage systems. All standard storage vessels from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are therefore equipped with a manual condensate drain.
Safety valve and pressure gauge
The storage design

A correctly dimensioned storage system is one of the key components of a high-pressure setup. It reduces pressure fluctuations during intermittent air withdrawal and decreases compressor start frequency by providing sufficient storage capacity. The pressure vessels and final separators in high-pressure compressors are designed for a limited number of load cycles. Fewer start-stop cycles significantly extend the service life of these components.

The I26 series comprises water-cooled high-pressure compressors for the compression of air and nitrogen. It is used whenever these gases need to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures and supplied over long periods in continuous operation. The I26 high-pressure compressors achieve final pressures from 90 to 420 bar. B-SELECT
Automatic selector unit

For simultaneous filling of pressure cylinders with air from
storage system and compressor
Inlet pressure up to 420 bar
Flow rate up to 850 bar

The automatic selector unit enables compressed air cylinders to be filled quickly and simultaneously in parallel from
a single storage system (buffer) and via one compressor.
Important! The automatic selector unit works most effectively when the nominal pressure in the storage system
and the breathing air cylinder are nearly the same.

HOW IT WORKS
Filling of the breathing air cylinder connected to the filling panel takes priority. This means that the storage system
and the compressor always fill the cylinder connected to the filling panel first. Once the cylinders are completely
filled, the automatic selector unit independently switches over to filling the storage system.

When the maximum filling pressure of the storage system is reached, the compressor shuts down fully
automatically. As soon as the next empty breathing air cylinder is connected to the filling panel, the storage system
again fills the breathing air cylinder first. If the preset restart pressure in the storage system is undershot, the
compressor switches on.

The compressor then fills the breathing air cylinder up to the value preset on the backpressure regulator / pressure

What delivery rates are possible with PE-VE compressors?
PE-VE compressors achieve delivery rates of approximately 85 to 800 l/min. The actual delivery rate depends on the model and the specific configuration.
Which gases are PE-VE compressors suitable for?
PE-VE compressors are designed for the compression of air, nitrogen, and forming gas. They are intended for reliable continuous operation in industrial environments.
What technically distinguishes PE-VE compressors?
The systems are based on proven BAUER high-pressure blocks and are designed for robustness, long service life, and continuous industrial duty. The design focuses on reliable technology and an especially attractive price-performance ratio.
How are PE-VE compressors controlled and monitored?
The compressor is equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system. It enables easy operation, safe monitoring of operating parameters, and connectivity to the B-CLOUD and B-APP.
What
are the benefits of B-CLOUD?
B-CLOUD enables centralized digital monitoring of the compressor. Operators have continuous access to operating data, can monitor system status, and plan maintenance more efficiently.

Details & Features
The water-cooled high-pressure boosters in the GIB series from BAUER KOMPRESSOREN are ideal for demanding industrial applications in continuous operation. Thanks to targeted water cooling of the compressor blocks and multi-stage compression, operating temperatures remain low and wear is minimised. The systems offer maximum gas tightness for loss-free compression up to 520 bar. Proven BAUER system components, robust construction and optimised power consumption ensure maximum efficiency. Low oil consumption, long maintenance intervals and transparent maintenance kits reduce operating costs (TCO) in the long term.
